resources.string: This car has been reported missing. If you found it or are not the owner, please call:
GUARD TEST: this is what the headunit shows when the car starts without a trusted phone.

Off. Set it up in the KlikBeam app (Pro): Garage › car › Anti-theft guard. If the car starts without the owner\'s phone, the headunit shows the owner\'s message until a PIN is entered, no internet needed.
On, set from the KlikBeam app. %1$s. The message shows %2$d min after the car starts if no trusted phone connects.
⚠ Permission to show over other apps is missing: the guard message can\'t appear. Tap ALLOW.
⚠ Location/permission is needed to recognise hotspots: allow location (also in the background) for KlikDash and turn location on, or turn off the headunit\'s own hotspot.
The anti-theft guard is on. Enter the guard PIN to open settings.
Opens by itself when a trusted phone connects. Forgot the PIN? Turn the guard off in the KlikBeam app while the headunit is online.
⚠ Usage access is not granted: Android Settings cannot be locked while the guard is on. Tap ALLOW, then turn it on for KlikDash.
